designDirection.style: Refined Makan identity: compact line glyphs, soft cards, original notebook-grid motif, restrained 150 ms feedback
designDirection.mobile: Single pane; three bottom tabs; glyphs 20 px / nav 22 px; standard hit targets 48 px, minimum 44 px; shortcut circles 48 px. Independent create/edit forms.
designDirection.tablet: Full-width stage with centered flow-layout bottom dock, 4–5 labeled role-aware destinations, max width 620 px, height 80 px, radius 26 px, 18 px bottom margin. No side rail. Split Messenger where useful. Hide dock during public/auth/form/exam/conversation focus, keep dedicated action footer.
designDirection.desktop: Right navigation retained; central reading/form column, left contextual panel; softer v2 styling.
designDirection.forms: One task per page; required labels and helper text; error adjacent to field; preserve unsaved draft; sticky save.
designDirection.accessibility: Readable 16 px body, glyph size separate from 44 px minimum / 48 px standard hit targets, visible focus, labels, semantic statuses, reduced-motion support.

globalConstraints: Sample data only; no invented measured KPIs, prices or testimonials.
No Stories/Reels/social followers, profile bio/post grid or voice/video calls; APIs do not support these.
Class, course, period edit APIs absent. Create pages supported; active edit routes excluded.
Published lessons and assessment versions immutable; explicit new exam version flow only.
No private child Direct/messages access in Parent/Manager or blanket platform access.
No MFA/TOTP/recovery/step-up screens in current contract.
Payment and AI capability states explicitly disabled/unavailable as contract specifies.
Human form labels exclude operation IDs and version tokens; these remain developer metadata.
Persian numerals for display; normalize input; ISO/Gregorian/UTC for transfer; Asia/Tehran for user time.
Show real maxScore, not an assumed global score of 20; absence of attendance is unrecorded.
source: Attached API contract, reviewed 2026-10-29, plus attached product diagram. Semantic capability labels; runtime success not proven.
